records.title: Demand for re-establishment, operationalization and upgradation of Cooch Behar Heritage Airport.
details:
Shri Nagendra Ray: 
I seek to draw attention of the Government
towards the need for the re-establishment and operationalization of the Cooch
Behar Heritage Airport, and its upgradation into a dual-use civil and military
airbase, in the larger interest of regional connectivity and economic
development defending national security from any hostile countries like China,
Pakistan, Bangladesh and other countries for religious terrorist activities. It
is a known fact that China and Bangladesh are targeting Siliguri Corridor as
the ?eye of a bird? from the Lalmonirhat Military airbase in Bangladesh to
disconnect North East from our Country.The Cooch Behar Heritage Airport holds
historical significance and is strategically located in North Bengal, close to
international borders. This airport had an outstanding role during 1st &
2nd world wars in 1914 and 1939. Given its geographical importance, revival and
development of this airport would greatly strengthen air connectivity in a
region. Re-establishing civil aviation operations from Cooch Behar would
significantly improve regional air connectivity, promote tourism, facilitate
business activities, and provide faster access to medical and emergency
services. At the same time, operationalization of the airport as a military
airbase would enhance strategic preparedness and logistical capability in this
sensitive border region, complementing national defence objectives.??? I also
request that the airport be upgraded with modern aviation infrastructure,
navigational and communication systems, safety and security installations, and
supporting road and utility connectivity. Development of allied infrastructure
would also generate employment opportunities and catalyze socio-economic growth
in the region.
(ENDS)

records.title: Demand for conferment of Bharat Ratna on Maharaja Jagaddipendra Narayan Bhup Bahadur of Cooch Behar.
REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF DEMAND OF THE GREATER COOCH BEHAR PEOPLE’S ASSOCIATION FOR FORMATION OF GREATER COOCH BEHAR AS UNION TERRITORY
details:
Shri Nagendra Ray: Sir, there has been a long pending
demand of the Greater Cooch Behar People?s Association since the year 2015 for formation of
Greater Cooch Behar as a Union Territory by carving it out of the State of West
Bengal. The Association has made a number of representations to the Government
in the past to realize aspirations of its people.? This Association has been
against merger of the then Cooch Behar with the States of West Bengal and?
Assam as they considered it illegal, unconstitutional and against the wishes of
the locals. For the knowledge of my colleagues here, I would like to mention
that the then Government was aware of the ground situation that merger of
Greater Cooch Behar with West Bengal and Assam is very sensitive because of violation
of the Instrument of Accession of State of Cooch Behar signed between Maharaja
Shri Jagaddipendra Narayan Bhup Bahadur and Lord Mountbatten, Governor General,
Dominion Govt. of India, on 9th? August, 1947 and Agreement Annexure ? ?A? made on 28th? and 30th? August, 1949. Interestingly Cooch
Behar was shown as ?C? category State in the First Schedule of the Constitution
adopted by Constituent Assembly on 26th November, 1949. Therefore, I would sincerely request Hon?ble Home
Minister to undo the injustice done to people of Cooch Behar by carving out it
as a separate Union Territory. 
(Ends)

records.title: Demand to conduct a comprehensive review for restoration of the original character and position of the Library as the Cooch Behar National Library in the larger interest of the Kshatriya Rajbanshi community
details:
Shri
Nagendra Ray:
Sir, Historically speaking, the establishment of the Cooch Behar National
Library at Cooch Behar Palace dates back to the year 1870.? This Library has
great heritage character and position among the local people of the Kshastriya
Rajbanshi community because of cultural and ethnical bond and values. It has a
huge collection of various types of rare books, Journals, magazines,
manuscripts, periodicals,? etc.?? The historical library was later re-named as
the North Bengal State library and? is situated in the heart of Cooch Behar
Town.? It is important to know that after the merger of Cooch Behar with the
Indian Dominion, the library was accorded A -Category Status. Later it was
renamed as North Bengal state library by West Bengal Govt. and in the process it
got B category status on 1st April, 1969. I humbly request the Central
Government to conduct a comprehensive review of the situation and order
restoration of the original character and position of the Library as the Cooch
Behar National Library in the larger interest of the Kshatriya Rajbanshi
community.
(Ends)
